fundamentals.name: Lumentum Holdings Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through two segments, Cloud & Networking and Industrial Tech. The Cloud & Networking segment offers optical and photonic chips, components, modules, and subsystems supplied to cloud data center operators, AI/ML infrastructure providers, and network equipment manufacturer customers that are building cloud data centers and network infrastructures. Its Industrial Tech segment provides short-pulse solid-state lasers, kilowatt-class fiber lasers, diode lasers, and gas lasers that serves the semiconductor device, solar cell, display, and electric vehicle and battery manufacturing markets. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

judgment.summary: High-growth company with strong analyst estimates but facing valuation and balance sheet concerns.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 4.6%; next earnings date is 2026-08-05.
positives: Revenue growth 90.1% YoY and analyst estimates of 236.6% for current Q and 300.7% for current FY indicate substantial top-line expansion.
Operating margin of 21.8% and profit margin of 17.7% demonstrate strong profitability.
Return on equity at 22.8% is healthy.
PEG ratio of 0.63 suggests the stock may be undervalued relative to its growth prospects.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 156.42 and Forward P/E of 49.00 indicate a high valuation.
Price/Book of 74.80 and Price/Sales of 27.73 also suggest the stock is richly valued.
Debt/Equity ratio of 111.44 indicates significant leverage.
Free cash flow of $93.35M is low relative to the company's market cap and debt.
Quick ratio of 0.94 suggests potential short-term liquidity challenges.

news.paragraph: Lumentum Holdings announced a $650.4 million private share exchange transaction, following a week where the stock saw a modest dip after its last earnings report. The company's shares also experienced significant gains earlier in the week, alongside other optical stocks, potentially influenced by a substantial Nvidia investment. Analysts are considering whether the stock is still undervalued given these developments.
